steps.name: Technician
steps.text: Wake up, Mr. Navigator!

steps.name: Navigator
steps.text: Didn't I say the route is fine...?

steps.name: Technician
steps.text: We just detected an unknown nomadic plate, when there shouldn't be any on our route.

steps.name: Technician
steps.text: We hailed them, and they're calling themselves Ognisko.

steps.name: Navigator
steps.text: Ognisko... Isn't that a stationary city?

steps.name: Navigator
steps.text: Did you check their call sign? Is it legal?

steps.name: Technician
steps.text: It is. The registered owner is...

steps.name: Technician
steps.text: Mr. McKee, of the Rose Paper Union.

steps.name: Enthusiastic Citizen
steps.text: Back for more of the same, Viviana? Soft bread and marjoram sausage?

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Wow, you still remember? I haven't stopped by in quite a while.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Thanks. I'll be back next time I'm in Ognisko.

steps.name: Enthusiastic Citizen
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Enthusiastic Citizen
steps.text: Sorry, but I'm about to close this shop down, maybe as early as next week. You'll have to go elsewhere next time.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: What? Why, if you don't mind telling me?

steps.name: Enthusiastic Citizen
steps.text: Found a new job, that's all. I'll still be a shopkeep, but I'll be selling weird trinkets instead. And I'll be getting paid for it instead of putting my own money in.

steps.name: Enthusiastic Citizen
steps.text: I've got you to thank for it, actually. We've had more jobs opening up around here ever since those reporters came looking for you with their cameras.

spans.text: to thank for it, actually. We've had more jobs opening up around here ever since those reporters came looking for you with their cameras.

steps.name: Enthusiastic Citizen
steps.text: Not that there's much I can do to thank you... how about we say this one's on me?

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: You're too kind. You don't owe me anything. In fact, there's something I want to ask you.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Do you know of any other shop on this street with food as good as yours? My master likes it the way you make them.

steps.name: Enthusiastic Citizen
steps.text: If you really want, you can come to my house and I'll make you some.

steps.name: Enthusiastic Citizen
steps.text: But I think you've got other things to worry about when it comes to your master...

steps.name: Enthusiastic Citizen
steps.text: Take good care of her, Viviana. She may have caused a bit of trouble, but nobody's really holding it against her.

steps.name: Enthusiastic Citizen
steps.text: She's the one who built a lot of our furnaces, after all.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Trouble?

steps.name: Enthusiastic Citizen
steps.text: Nothing serious. Guess it's just hard to accept change at that age, stubborn as she is.

steps.name: Enthusiastic Citizen
steps.text: Viviana?

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Oh, nothing. I just thought I saw someone I knew.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Do a lot of people wear suits in Ognisko these days?

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: I'm back, master. I put your food on the table.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: I told you, just call me Obina.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: What about the iron? The food I can live without, but not the iron.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Yes, but you can only have it after you've eaten.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: If I let you light your furnace first, you'll forget to eat all day.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: Hah! I'm tough, I can take it.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: 'Everyone breaks. The only thing that doesn't is iron.' You said that yourself.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: I say a lot of things!

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: I also said, 'The first smith on the great plains caught the fire that fell from the sky, lifted the metal that grew from the ground, and hammered it for nine days and nights without rest.'

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: By comparison, I'm downright lazy. And that won't do. The fire in the furnace goes out quick if you're lazy.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: Now where are the tongs? Fetch 'em for me.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: You can't fool me that easily.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: But you do seem like you're in good spirits today. I haven't heard you talk so much in a long time. I was worrying about you on the way back.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: ...Am I talking a lot today?

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Normally, you'd just say 'Give me the tongs.'

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: Alright, I...

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: I just wanted to ask when you're leaving.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Tomorrow morning, at first light. You didn't have to be so roundabout about it.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: You won't stay?

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: Just another half a month... or even a few days?

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: I can put this workshop under your name. We can keep hammering iron together. I made the ceiling higher, so you won't keep hitting your antlers on it.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: I... didn't expect you to want me to stay.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: I'll be going, master.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: It's your life. Just don't forget anything.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: I'm saying goodbye now because the ride's really early tomorrow, and I don't want to wake you.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: What am I, your mother? You don't my permission to leave. No need for goodbyes, either. Just go where you want—it's none of my business.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: You don't need to tell me even if you become Grand Knight.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: I know, you've never been concerned about those things.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Just like you've never cared who I am, or where I'm from.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: Hah! You're you. Who else could you be?

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Thank you. That means more to me than any words of praise.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: How would you know? I haven't praised you before.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: But you did do good work when you were hammering iron with me. You're got nimble hands and a calm heart. You've got potential.

spans.text: do good work when you were hammering iron with me. You're got nimble hands and a calm heart. You've got potential.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: As for whatever you do elsewhere, I'm not gonna poke my nose into that. Just don't get yourself killed.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: I won't, master.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: I'll be back to see you someday.

steps.name: Impatient Reporter
steps.text: Candle Knight! Why have you chosen to leave Ognisko? Where are you going next?

steps.name: Excited Reporter
steps.text: What do you think about Moonlight Knight's performance this spring, after she replaced you in the Nova Knightclub?

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Sorry, folks, but I have a ride to catch... It leaves in ten minutes.

steps.name: Excited Reporter
steps.text: You're avoiding the question, Madam Droste...

steps.name: Impatient Reporter
steps.text: Candle Knight! One moment—

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: What are you taking all those photos for?

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: You never seen a human before?!

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: You like to talk, right? How about you tell me what makes Viviana different from anyone else?

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: How is where she's going any of your business?! Get lost.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: ...Thank you.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: I... didn't expect you to want me to stay.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: Tsk. Forget I said anything.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: I must still be half-asleep... I'm heading out now.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Where to? I already bought everything.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: Don't worry about it, Viviana.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: And don't follow me.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: Get the furnace lit. You can forge anything you want today. Then you can go wherever you want tomorrow.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Mr. McKee.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: What are you doing here?

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: I just watched that blacksmith leave. Hard to imagine that I'd see an old woman with the same kind of aura I see in knights going to war.

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: She reminds me of a certain other stubborn person... someone who had a great influence on you.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Obina is just an ordinary blacksmith. She has nothing to do with anyone you know, and there's nothing worth digging into there.

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: Madam Droste... the last time I saw you take such a firm stance was when you refused to use extraordinary methods to defeat the Radiant Knight at the Major.

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: I had thought the Radiant Knight would look after you after you were 'reassigned' to Ognisko, but she has her own path to walk, and it's been hard for her to come see you.

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: So I was relieved to learn that you met someone in Ognisko who could take care of you... even if she's just an ordinary blacksmith.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Obina has nothing in common with the Radiant Knight, and the care she shows for me has nothing to do with her either.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: She did, however, help me experience a sort of... peace, which I had never felt before.

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: I can only imagine how precious that peace is to you.

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: That's why I wanted to let you know that, whether it be that blacksmith or Ognisko itself, there is, in fact, something worth digging into here. Even if you'd rather not think so.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: ...How much do you know about the recent changes in Ognisko?

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: I know that the nomadic platforms parked outside the city belong to Glorious Shield Industries, and that they're being used to rebuild the city.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Those colorful ribbons on the houses, those plastic flowers on the branches, even the model weapons and knight emblems on the streets... they all came from Glorious Shield?

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: And those people pretending to hammer iron behind glass windows... they're on Glorious Shield's payroll, aren't they?

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: And Glorious Shield's partners.

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: A large Knightclub like Nova produces their stars in specific ways. Theme songs, slogans, ways of speaking, ways of fighting, outfits, backstories, ideologies...

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: A competition knight's career in the arena only lasts so long. No knight, no matter how professional, can ever fully fill the spiritual needs of the fans.

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: However, the gaps can be filled with exhibitions, concerts, talk shows, and books.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: So, weapons manufacturers like Glorious Shield are trying to give their products 'story' and 'character', to fill these spiritual gaps of the fans, so to speak?

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: And they've selected Ognisko as the backdrop for it?

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: The ancient city of forests and craftsmen, with a proud heritage of forging dating back to the wild ages. Is there a better choice?

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: It will become a huge film studio, where all the inhabitants are actors performing legends of forging.

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: Smiths will be able to make a decent living without the sweat and toil of bending down in front of a furnace, and Glorious Shield will have access to 'divine weapons' that look just like the stuff of legend.

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: ...At least, that's what was supposed to happen.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Then... I take it Obina was asked to join in on that 'performance'?

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: I don't know the details. But an old blacksmith who gave her whole life to crafting, and someone who's so closely connected to you of all people... Is there a better choice?

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: They may take... less accommodating measures with her.

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: If she's as stubborn as I imagine, then she may have already gotten a strong response from them, given what I know of Glorious Shield.

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: If so, I'd be just as angry as you. It would mean Glorious Shield is still lacking in consideration.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: I have to find her!

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: Wait, Madam Droste...

steps.name: Worried Smith
steps.text: Stop this foolishness, Obina.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: You want to play along with them, let them shut you in a show window?

steps.name: Glorious Shield Spokesman
steps.text: You know as well as I do that your actions are meaningless, ma'am. The glass that you broke today will be fixed by tomorrow.

steps.name: Glorious Shield Spokesman
steps.text: The damages you'll be liable for are more than you can afford. All you're hurting is your own livelihood.

steps.name: Glorious Shield Spokesman
steps.text: Unless, of course, you sign this agreement, in which case the damages will be deducted from your wages.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: You say I'm hurting my own livelihood?

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: I didn't bring a stack of kurwa 'agreements' to ask for the privilege to close my own workshop and pretend hammer iron with a rubber hammer in a show window!

steps.name: Worried Smith
steps.text: You know some of the apprentices don't really like hammering iron.

steps.name: Worried Smith
steps.text: And not all of us old folks are as strong and healthy as you. In a couple of years, I'm not sure I'll be able to lift a real hammer myself.

steps.name: Worried Smith
steps.text: But we need a way forward.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: The smiths of Ognisko have lifted their hammers since before there were even any castles on the great plains.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: Did you forget the meaning of the name 'Ognisko'?

steps.name: Worried Smith
steps.text: 'Furnace'. I've never forgotten.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: Then you know that to forge was our way forward, is our way forward, and will always be our way forward.

spans.text: Then you know that to forge
our way forward, and will always be our way forward.

steps.name: Glorious Shield Spokesman
steps.text: Er, I apologize for interrupting, but the town council is also planning to rename the city.

steps.name: Glorious Shield Spokesman
steps.text: Once Glorious Shield's branding experts arrive, the city will have a new name, one more suited for a new era.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: You—!

steps.name: Glorious Shield Spokesman
steps.text: Whaagh!

steps.name: Glorious Shield Spokesman
steps.text: Ahem... you have that on camera? Please cut my reaction. But keep the segment of Madam Obina swinging her hammer at me.

steps.name: Glorious Shield Spokesman
steps.text: Allowing you to deduct the damages from your wages after signing the agreement is a special exception we're willing to make just for you, ma'am.

steps.name: Glorious Shield Spokesman
steps.text: Normally, we would simply call the police and deal with this properly.

steps.name: Glorious Shield Spokesman
steps.text: Compared to prison, however, I'm sure you would—

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: I'm sure you would prefer to end this conflict and give yourself time to admire the sights of Ognisko—before it's destroyed by your company's engineering casters.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: After all, until your company's experts arrive, none of your hard work here will be seen by your superiors.

steps.name: Glorious Shield Spokesman
steps.text: Finally, the Candle Knight! Casters, zoom in on her, and get a few more drones on it...

steps.name: Glorious Shield Spokesman
steps.text: What do you mean, the screen's all black? Did you forget to take off the lens cover?

steps.name: Glorious Shield Spokesman
steps.text: Candle Knight... your Arts...

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: I've visited your headquarters before. Every reception room has thick curtains to block out the light.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: You know as well as I do that some things are unsuited for being admired by everyone under the light.

steps.name: Glorious Shield Spokesman
steps.text: I hope you understand that I'm simply defending my company's lawful interests.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Your losses will be reasonably compensated.

steps.name: Glorious Shield Spokesman
steps.text: Thank you for your understanding. Now perhaps you would be interested in hearing our plans...

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Maybe another day.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Let's go, Obina.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: Viviana, I told you...

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: I told you not to follow me...

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: I'm sorry. You never asked about my situation, so it would be tactless of me to ask about yours.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: However, in this case, your business is also mine.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: ...Your legs are shaking. Come, take my arm.

steps.name: Glorious Shield Spokesman
steps.text: What are you just standing there for? Haven't you got any backup cameras? Go catch up to them!

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Haven't you already gotten enough material for days worth of headlines?

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: I suggest you stop.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Unless you want to replace all your camera sensors.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Is this why you wanted me to stay, Obina?

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: You wanted me to protect the workshop.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: May sparks burn my mouth, Viviana. I shouldn't have said anything about wanting you to stay, or gone to wreck their place before you left.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: I'm too old, and I've gone soft, like a hunk of iron that's spent too long in the flames.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: There isn't much difference between protecting the workshop and buying materials for you.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: You could have told me directly. It's not a sign of weakness.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: No, Viviana... I didn't plan on asking for your help at all.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: I tried everything. But as you can see, it's no use, no matter how many of their windows I break.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: What difference can one person make? They have hundreds, thousands of people...

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: But... but...

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: Someone told me that you're a noble, a knight. Your voice is worth a hundred, a thousand of us ordinary folk. Someone told me that if the workshop belonged to you, no one would dare mess with it.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: I'm at the end of my wits here. Sorry, Viviana...

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: Help me, Candle Knight.
The Candle Knight. How many have called her by that name?
Viviana has long since lost count. When she hears the title, she reflexively turns around and bows, just as a light turns on when the switch is flipped.
An instinctive numbness, a numb instinct.
Right now, however, Obina calling her by that title sends a shiver up her spine.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: I don't know any other way to apologize, but I want you to know...

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: I'm sorry.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: I'll think of a way. I promise.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: But I don't understand.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: I just don't understand...

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Why are you the one who has to feel guilty? Be it between friends, or between master and student, it's not at all unusual to need each other's help.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: It's partly my fault that you're in such difficult straits. If I hadn't drawn so much attention to Ognisko...

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: I've never even repaid you for taking me in as your student, but I ended up causing you so much trouble. If anyone should feel guilty, it would be me.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: It's not the same, Viviana.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: But never mind. Thank you for being willing to help.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: At least the workshop will still be there for you the next time you come back... If you still have a reason to.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: ...Do you want me to light the furnace for you?

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: No, I won't be smithing today.
Ognisko seems to have become awfully quiet.
In the past, the sound of metal banging on metal would be echoing through the city at this hour, and Obina would be humming a random tune to match the rhythm of it. It was a reassuring kind of noise.
Now, however, the only thing she hears is the rustling of leaves.
Is it because all the smiths have agreed to close their shops? But why are even the fowlbeasts silent?
Suddenly, Viviana hears a familiar voice in the distance—
'Glorious Shield Industries military products, guaranteed to help you conquer the wilderness and repel any Catastrophes!'

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: 'Dear Mr. Zamark. Concerning the rebuilding of Ognisko...'

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: You agreed to help the blacksmith.

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: Who will help YOU, then?

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: ...What are you getting at?

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: You weren't this melancholic when you refused to use extraordinary methods to defeat the Radiant Knight.

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: The Viviana Droste I know has a light in her eyes when she decides to embark on a little rebellion.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: You've always been so sensitive to subtle emotions.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Perhaps you could have been a poet, if the Rose Paper Union still published poems.

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: Nonsense. I should be thanking you for helping me understand the value of poetry.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: And I should thank you for your concern.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: I'm fine. It's just that I don't quite understand everything yet. First, I need to finish this letter.

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: There was no need for you to deal with them on your own... We could have saved this workshop, even all of Ognisko, together.

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: Glorious Shield is being short-sighted. It won't take long for people to start asking why all of these so-called legendary weapons are coming from the same city.

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: The fate of a city that fades back into obscurity is even darker than one that never had its day in the sun.

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: You appreciate Ognisko's beauty more than Glorious Shield's surveyors, and beauty is eternal... so long as you can bring it out.

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: You said you couldn't write poems in Kawalerielki, but Ognisko is the birthplace of freedom, the land of poets. Is it not?

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: Write a poem about Ognisko, and we can develop this place in a different manner.

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: Everyone will have better lives, without having to change their way of living.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: And why are you doing this? You've only been here for a few days.

spans.text: doing this? You've only been here for a few days.

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: But you've lived in this city, and found a peace that you've never known before. Isn't that what you said?

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: I would think that would be reason enough.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Just because I find comfort here?

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: Of course, Madam Droste.

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: Most knights assigned to 'recuperate' in remote towns can't wait to leave them.

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: You, however, have repeatedly visited Ognisko. Is there another reason, other than this being a place of comfort for you?

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: A place of comfort...
The birthplace of freedom.

steps.name: Worried Smith
steps.text: But we need a way forward.
The land of poets.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: Then you know that to forge was our way forward, is our way forward, and will always be our way forward.

spans.text: Then you know that to forge
our way forward, and will always be our way forward.

steps.text: Viviana's place of comfort.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: I'm at the end of my wits here. Help me, Candle Knight.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: I'm sorry.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: My place of comfort is a place of comfort for Viviana alone.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Just because I like the shade of the trees, and the songs of the fowlbeasts, the furnaces and the sparks, just because...

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Just because I like how the people here don't care where I came from, who I am, and where I'm going.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: You know this, and so does Obina.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: That's why you proposed to protect Ognisko 'for me', and why she felt so guilty about asking for my help.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: She feared that even saying the words 'Candle Knight' would destroy my place of comfort.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: She didn't want to ruin my hopes for her because of her powerlessness.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Even if I'm the very cause of her dilemma.

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: Even if you never came to Ognisko, all of this would still have occurred eventually.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: McKee...

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Thank you for the kind offer.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: But I can't accept it.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: I, and only I, am responsible for Obina's changes.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: She thought that seeking my help would ruin everything she meant to me. She was ashamed of it, and suffered so much from it...

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: ...As if she weren't my master or my friend, but just a tool to give me comfort.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: If so, is there really any difference between my poetry and Glorious Shield's film studio?

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: If that's what my poems are...

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Then I will write no poems for Ognisko.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Henceforth, Viviana's poems shall only be of herself.

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: As always, your resolve is... surprising.

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: And there I was, thinking I'd finally come to know you after all these years.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: You already know me quite well, McKee.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: It's Obina whom you don't know, although even I've only started to know just her moments ago. Far too late.

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: ...Hm. I guess even your thinking can change.

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: It's like chasing after the horizon. Every time I take a step forward, it takes a step back.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: My thinking so far has mostly been naive, and not nearly worth the effort of understanding. I simply fear that what happened to Obina will happen to you too.

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: Maybe I just wanted some kind of salvation. I can't help but feel that I'm constantly sinking, even as the Rose Paper Union's stock prices continue to rise.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Well, if you're still seeking 'salvation' from me... then allow me to borrow your name.

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: My name?

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Most of my assets in Kazimierz are frozen under the Nova Knightclub name, but there may still be enough to purchase a small nomadic platform.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: So if you're willing to help, it may be more appropriate to make the purchase under your name.

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: What do you need a nomadic platform for?

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: To take Ognisko away, or at least the people who still see her as a furnace.

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: ...Very well.

steps.name: Viviana
steps.text: Let's go. The furnace that was born on the plains shall return to the plains.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: Is everyone here?

steps.name: Excited Blacksmith
steps.text: Everyone who still wants to hammer iron rather than play along with that farce.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: Good! There's hope for Ognisko yet. The flames yet burn in the furnace of the great plains.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: We're about to sail, Master McKee! There's no issue, is there?
From the deck of the nomadic platform, McKee casts his gaze towards the wilderness in the distance.
A faint flame flickers in the darkness. In its light, Viviana's green cape looks like a ghost, drifting in the wind.
At least, that is how he would describe it, if he were writing a poem.

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: She's gone.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: She'll be back.

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: Her outfit...

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: I had someone make it for her when she was living in Ognisko. A knight's garb isn't exactly for everyday use.

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: I thought she would disassociate herself completely from Ognisko.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: Before she left, she asked me whether I truly felt happy when we were hammering iron together by the forge.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: I was happy. Of course I was.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: She said she was too. And she said that was enough.

steps.name: Obina
steps.text: Then, she asked me to take out that outfit and help her put it on.

steps.name: McKee
steps.text: 'Henceforth, Viviana's poems shall only be of herself'...
